paragraphs.text: 1. As sits the young bird on the tree rejoicing, ye, swift Pair, have been roused by clear laudation,
paragraphs.original: वने न वा यो न्यधायि चाकञ्छुचिर्वां स्तोमो भुरणावजीगः । यस्येदिन्द्रः पुरुदिनेषु होता नृणां नर्यो नृतमः क्षपावान्
paragraphs.translit: vane na vā yo nyadhāyi cākañchucirvāṃ stomo bhuraṇāvajīgaḥ | yasyedindraḥ purudineṣu hotā nṛṇāṃ naryo nṛtamaḥ kṣapāvān

paragraphs.text: Whose Herald-Priest through many days is Indra, earth's Guardian, Friend of men, the best of Heroes.
Let the victorious car with triple splendour bring hitherward the hundred chiefs with Kutsa.
3. What was the gladdening draught that pleased thee, Indra? Speed through our doors to songs, for thou art mighty.
paragraphs.original: कस्ते मद इन्द्र रन्त्यो भूद्दुरो गिरो अभ्युग्रो वि धाव ।
paragraphs.translit: kaste mada indra rantyo bhūdduro giro abhyugro vi dhāva |

paragraphs.text: Why comest thou to me, what gift attracts thee? Fain would I bring thee food most meet to offer.
paragraphs.original: कद्वाहो अर्वागुप मा मनीषा आ त्वा शक्यामुपमं राधो अन्नैः
paragraphs.translit: kadvāho arvāgupa mā manīṣā ā tvā śakyāmupamaṃ rādho annaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Indra, what fame hath one like thee mid heroes? With what plan wilt thou act? Why hast thou sought us?
paragraphs.original: कदु द्युम्नमिन्द्र त्वावतो नॄन्कया धिया करसे कन्न आगन् ।
paragraphs.translit: kadu dyumnamindra tvāvato nṝnkayā dhiyā karase kanna āgan |

paragraphs.text: As a true Friend, Wide-Strider! to sustain us, since food absorbs the thought of each among us.
paragraphs.original: मित्रो न सत्य उरुगाय भृत्या अन्ने समस्य यदसन्मनीषाः
paragraphs.translit: mitro na satya urugāya bhṛtyā anne samasya yadasanmanīṣāḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Speed happily those, as Surya ends his journey, who meet his wish as bridegrooms meet their spouses;
paragraphs.original: प्रेरय सूरो अर्थं न पारं ये अस्य कामं जनिधा इव ग्मन् ।
paragraphs.translit: preraya sūro arthaṃ na pāraṃ ye asya kāmaṃ janidhā iva gman |

paragraphs.text: Men who present, O Indra strong by nature, with food the many songs that tell thy praises.
paragraphs.original: गिरश्च ये ते तुविजात पूर्वीर्नर इन्द्र प्रतिशिक्षन्त्यन्नैः
paragraphs.translit: giraśca ye te tuvijāta pūrvīrnara indra pratiśikṣantyannaiḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Thine are two measures, Indra, wide-well meted, heaven for thy majesty, earth for thy wisdom.
paragraphs.original: मात्रे नु ते सुमिते इन्द्र पूर्वी द्यौर्मज्मना पृथिवी काव्येन ।
paragraphs.translit: mātre nu te sumite indra pūrvī dyaurmajmanā pṛthivī kāvyena |

paragraphs.text: Here for thy choice are Somas mixed with butter: may the sweet meath be pleasant for thy drinking.
paragraphs.original: वराय ते घृतवन्तः सुतासः स्वाद्मन्भवन्तु पीतये मधूनि
paragraphs.translit: varāya te ghṛtavantaḥ sutāsaḥ svādmanbhavantu pītaye madhūni

paragraphs.text: 7. They have poured out a bowl to him, to Indra, full of sweet juice, for faithful is his bounty.
paragraphs.original: आ मध्वो अस्मा असिचन्नमत्रमिन्द्राय पूर्णं स हि सत्यराधाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ā madhvo asmā asicannamatramindrāya pūrṇaṃ sa hi satyarādhāḥ |

paragraphs.text: O'er earth's expanse hath he grown great by wisdom, the Friend of man, and by heroic exploits.
paragraphs.original: स वावृधे वरिमन्ना पृथिव्या अभि क्रत्वा नर्यः पौंस्यैश्च
paragraphs.translit: sa vāvṛdhe varimannā pṛthivyā abhi kratvā naryaḥ pauṃsyaiśca

paragraphs.text: 8. Indra hath conquered in his wars, the Mighty: men strive in multitudes to win his friendship.
paragraphs.original: व्यानळिन्द्रः पृतनाः स्वोजा आस्मै यतन्ते सख्याय पूर्वीः ।
paragraphs.translit: vyānaḷindraḥ pṛtanāḥ svojā āsmai yatante sakhyāya pūrvīḥ |

paragraphs.text: Ascend thy chariot as it were in battle, which thou shalt drive to us with gracious favour.
paragraphs.original: आ स्मा रथं न पृतनासु तिष्ठ यं भद्रया सुमत्या चोदयासे
paragraphs.translit: ā smā rathaṃ na pṛtanāsu tiṣṭha yaṃ bhadrayā sumatyā codayāse
